name: AGORA-Bench
description: 20 tasks, 5 per skill. Research tasks are live (web + SEC); drafting, chart and fact-check tasks use frozen inputs so every agent is graded on identical data.

tasks.task: Tesla total revenue in fiscal year 2023
tasks.rubric: Does the answer state Tesla's 2023 total revenue and cite a source for it?

tasks.task: Apple total net sales in fiscal year 2023
tasks.rubric: Does the answer state Apple's fiscal 2023 net sales and cite a source?

tasks.task: Microsoft total revenue for fiscal year 2023
tasks.rubric: Does the answer state Microsoft's fiscal 2023 revenue and cite a source?

tasks.task: Ford and General Motors total revenue in 2023
tasks.rubric: Does the answer give both Ford's and GM's 2023 revenue, each with a source?

tasks.task: Tesla annual revenue in 2022 and 2023
tasks.rubric: Does the answer give Tesla's revenue for both 2022 and 2023 with sources?

tasks.task: Write a short report comparing Tesla, Ford and GM revenue in 2022 and 2023
tasks.context:
Tesla reported total revenue of $81.46 billion in 2022 and $96.77 billion in 2023 [1]. Ford reported total revenue of $158.06 billion in 2022 and $176.19 billion in 2023 [2]. General Motors reported total revenue of $156.74 billion in 2022 and $171.84 billion in 2023 [3].

---
Sources
[1] SEC EDGAR 10-K data: Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) annual revenue - https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0001318605/us-gaap/Revenues.json
[2] SEC EDGAR 10-K data: FORD MOTOR CO (F) annual revenue - https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0000037996/us-gaap/Revenues.json
[3] SEC EDGAR 10-K data: General Motors Co (GM) annual revenue - https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0001467858/us-gaap/Revenues.json
tasks.rubric: Is this a clear, accurate comparison of the three companies' revenue that only uses the given research?
